title: Australian Bush Bread
description: A traditional Australian recipe for a hearty bread made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the Australian wheat flour, yeast, and salt.
2. Gradually add the water, mixing until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
6. Punch down the dough and shape into a round loaf.
7. Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, dust with flour, and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown.
8. Brush the loaf with olive oil and let it cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
